_comment: Copy this file, fill in the prices you read yourself, and pass it with
--pricing. Entries here are laid over plumbline's shipped table, so you can
price a vendor plumbline ships no figures for, or correct a shipped price
that has gone stale, without editing the package.
The numbers below are placeholders. plumbline does not ship a tariff for
TypeSafe: its customer agreement treats pricing information as confidential,
so reading the published page and writing the figure down is your act, not
plumbline's. The page is named in the shipped entry's source.
Key every model string that can appear. An alias resolves server-side and
the response reports a version, and pricing prefers whatever answered, so a
table keyed only on the alias prices every live row as model_not_priced.
There is no prefix matching: jev-1.14.0 will not inherit jev-1.13.0's rate.
source and as_of are required on every entry. Use null, never 0, where a
vendor publishes no price: null is the absence of a claim and 0 is the claim
Keys starting with an underscore are skipped, so this note can stay.

jev-1.13.0.source: TypeSafe published tariff, https://docs.typesafe.ai/models.md, read by me
jev-1.13.0.note: Placeholder figures. Replace with what the page says, and set as_of to the day you read it.

jev-latest.source: TypeSafe published tariff, https://docs.typesafe.ai/models.md, read by me
jev-latest.note: The alias, in case a run is costed before any response has reported a version.
